title: Let admins refund an order
body: Adds POST /orders/:id/refund so support can refund a paid order in full without editing the database.

labels.note: POST /orders/:id/refund is registered with requireUser only. Cancel, the other admin action, also has requireAdmin, so any signed-in member can refund any paid order in full. Commit 2 fixes it in src/app.ts, which mounts requireAdmin on the refund path before the order routes, and leaves src/routes/orders.ts unchanged.
